notes.title: Textures Update and New Global Map
notes.notes:
Ahoy!

ːjollyrːThis is one of the biggest visual leaps Sea Dogs series ever had. We've revamped over 200 textures along with the Global Map - most of the work involved manual reimagining of textures that hadn't been updated since the 2000s. The effort has started not so long ago, so we are definetely planning to bring more in the post release era. 

Take a look for yourself and don't forget to watch in fullscreen and 2K.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q9InsWxBoTg

ːjollyrːOwners of the Exclusive Edition will get the pre-release access and the opportunity to experience everything for themselves tomorrow. If you haven't secured your copy yet, fear not! Feb 8th marks the beginning of the final round of sales for the Exclusive Edition and it will last until Feb 17th.

Good hunting, pirates
ːauthorityː

notes.title: Demo Update and Free Steam Keys!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/0074fdc34df7a08fcceb8bf47049665c44930b67.jpg
Ahoy!

As Steam Next Fest approaches and the release date draws near (Caribbean Legend becomes available on February 15th), we have some exciting updates to share:

ːjollyrː We've made significant improvements to the demo, addressing all major stability issues identified so far, and we've raised the level cap to 10. This means you can enjoy at least eight hours of gameplay!

Please note that while the demo doesn't feature updated textures (which is a significant update), the story mode, or a substantial portion of the full release content, it still provides the ultimate pirate freeplay experience!

ːjollyrː We'll be discontinuing the demo permanently on February 12th, making way for Caribbean Legend: Sandbox – a free version of the game with no level cap whatsoever.

ːjollyrː To celebrate, we've organized a Steam key giveaway for the full version of the game!
Participating is easy – simply download the demo, play the game, capture a screenshot, share it on Twitter using the hashtags #caribbeanlegend and #SteamNextFest, and don't forget to tag @ValkyrieInitia1.

Once Steam Next Fest concludes, we'll select three lucky participants who will receive a complimentary Steam key! This is the second and the last free giveaway we are doing for Caribbean Legend.

ːjollyrː 10 days until the release! Caribbean Legend sets sail on February 15th, with a $24.99 price tag after the release discount. Normally, we would offer a 10% or 15% discount for a week, but we're giving all Sea Dogs and Open World RPG fans a chance to snag the best deal possible – a 25% discount for two whole weeks!

ːjollyrː We will also be adjusting prices for different regions of the world, ensuring fair pricing according to local spending power.

ːjollyrː Important reminder: Exclusive Edition owners will enjoy pre-release access on February 8th. This edition boasts a ton of unique content, and your last chance to acquire it will be from the 8th to the 17th of February. Hop aboard our Discord to ensure you don't miss the ship on this final opportunity! 

Good hunting, pirates.
ːauthorityː

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 - Release Date Update!
notes.notes:
Ahoy!ːseawolvesː

Among the news today are a new piece of soundtrack, news of a release date, and screenshots of updated warships and new locations.

Item 1

New music track - for a more pleasant reading. We’ve made new tavern themes, all are based on real-life shanties!

https://youtu.be/fnomZ5lX0cs

Item 2

Our release date was moved up to Q1 2022 due to the volume of feedback we were receiving over the past months - our task list almost doubled. 

While we won't be able to include all of it in the release, we will continue to release free updates. Thanks to the major upgrade of the game engine, you won't have to start a new game each time we air something big.

Item 3

The extra time spent waiting for the release will be compensated by a free update that lets you play some of the content from the upcoming Legendary Edition. It’s almost done and we expect to launch it in late January.

Item 4

Remember the warships from the original game? Their textures were bad, and their models were clunky. Our team is currently reforging all warships in Legendary Edition so that they project respect, fear, and power. We have already finished the Dutch and French warships. The Spaniard is currently in progress - you can see it all below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/969848a7b55725e0852270e6d72a161ca1b6284f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/346f1868749546ef2b1b7fe0acd7af7688fa0a53.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/234eda7cf07dad1360e4ed142ed13ee7cadbdc07.jpg

Item 5

The Legendary Edition will feature a whole new ship. Perhaps a pirate/raider galleon that shines in the midgame. We feel that there is a gap between quest post ships and warships in the game.

Item 6

There will be a change on a certain island in Legendary Edition. If you ever wished for a proper pirate base, you will surely get one! See some work in progress screenshots below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/84fe623cd0d2bd32129b4f09dd25902baa977336.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/9e9b3f15709530c8b4c7278c1af3c920c8bf9a58.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/47825b5beb18896051964a362e1e6ba009747c38.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048488/7fd967b9444f6ea4aa7d8ad5d713c1c5f82dae82.jpg

Item 7

When will we update screenshots and a trailer on the Steam Page? Although we have already taken care of all the necessary music and voice overs, we want to take pictures and video footage from a build with maxed out visuals, new locations, new weather, fog, sky, etc. We don't have such a build ready yet, but we are not far from it now - the Steam Page will be updated early next year.

Make sure to join our Discord channel for a direct line of communication with developers and exclusive materials about the game and its development!
